item.title: BhAskaraH 2
item.description:
Source: TW

Beed

One of the greatest H mathematician-scientist bhAskara-II says he was “sahya-kulAchalAshrita-vijjaDaviDa-nagara-nivAsI.” The town is today the provincial town of Beed in mahArAShTra state. There is a little chAlukya age temple in the town, but otherwise desolate from marUnmatta action. From today’s state, who would imagine that a man who brought such glory to his people, the very pinnacle of their intellectual expression, would have adorned a town such as this?
